read.name: plan_list
read.description: List all plans under .plan/ with per-wave task progress counts.

read.name: plan_dag
read.description: Return DAG stats for a plan: wave counts, ready/active/blocked states, and Boss Critical Path.

read.name: plan_next
read.description: Compile the O(1) Cognitive Micro-Brief for the next ready task of a plan.

read.name: plan_recall
read.description: Hybrid BM25 (+optional Ollama) semantic recall over the Cognitive Brain.

read.name: plan_impact
read.description: Compute the 2-hop blast radius of a file path or task URN from the Brain knowledge graph.

read.name: plan_graph
read.description: Export a knowledge-graph subgraph (nodes + edges) as JSON.

write.name: plan_claim
write.description: Claim a task lease (BEGIN IMMEDIATE) for exclusive execution.

write.name: plan_verify
write.description: Run the verify commands of a task and report results.

write.name: plan_complete
write.description: Mark a task complete: verify, scope-check, seal DAG-Merkle proof, optional atomic commit.

write.name: plan_fail
write.description: Record a task failure episode with a reason (feeds model-tier escalation).

write.name: plan_sync
write.description: Run Non-REM sleep consolidation and report invariant proposals.
